name: relay_channel
title: The relay library protects a channel between users
summary: This is a library flow for planned module clients. No shipped program routes it yet. The relay sees both identities in the handshake, then ciphertext, sizes and timing.

nodes.title: User A
nodes.note: Signs its handshake with both identity keys, checks the expected peer and derives relay keys from X25519 and ML-KEM, plus the optional agreed PSK.

nodes.title: Relay
nodes.note: Routes records without a channel key. The library handshake exposes both identities and invite context to it.

nodes.title: User B
nodes.note: Checks context and both signatures before deriving the channel keys. Its own YTP session, when integrated, ends at the relay server.
